name: reactor-mode-4e-limit-damage
description: #130: Cloud's limit gauge rises when he takes damage. From "battle", 1800 frames with no input (the guards attack, as in reactor-mode-4c): current HP decreased (hp_dir -1, the control), g_BattleWork.party[0].limitBar increased (lim_dir 1), and the savemap record's limit bar is unchanged during the battle (rec_dir 0). act_dir: the sign of g_ActiveCharacters[0].unk1A's change, reported only. Attempt 1 ruled out the other documented g_BattleWork base, 0x800F5BBC. Signs only. match: a rerun from the same snapshot.

game_state.description: g_GameState (s16 as u16; confirmed #76): field 1, battle 2, menu 5.

hp0.description: g_ActiveCharacters[0] (0x8009D84C, stride 0x440, indexed by party slot; confirmed #78/#101) + 0x010: current HP (s16; confirmed #78). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@d4db3de (reference only, no code) include/game.h ActiveCharacterData; ff7-flat-wiki Battle_Mechanics "Active Character Data"

lim0.description: g_BattleWork (0x800F5BB8, Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@d4db3de (reference only, no code) config/symbols.battle.txt; #130 attempt 1 ruled out 0x800f5bbc from config/sym_export_battle.us.txt) + 0x2A8 party[0] (BattlePartyWork, 0x34 bytes) + 0x08 limitBar (src/battle/battle.h; batini.c seeds it from the record's limit_charge, batres.c writes it back)

act_lim0.description: g_ActiveCharacters[0] + 0x01A: unk1A (Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@d4db3de (reference only, no code) include/game.h; batini.c sets it to limitBar << 8)

lim_rec0.description: Savemap (0x8009C6E4) + 0x0054 + 0x84 * 0 (character record 0) + 0x0F: the limit bar (ff7-flat-wiki Savemap "Character Record"; Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@d4db3de (reference only, no code) include/game.h SavePartyMember.limit_charge). Written back from the battle's limitBar when the battle ends (batres.c), so unchanged during it.
